apple_ios.name: Cranamp
apple_ios.subtitle: Music player and skin editor
apple_ios.description:
Cranamp plays your music in a compact player with original Catamp pixel skins. Import compatible WSZ or ZIP skins, or make your own in Skin Studio.

MUSIC AND PLAYLISTS
Open local audio files or an audio stream URL. Import M3U, M3U8 and PLS playlists, search your tracks, and use shuffle or repeat. Export playlists as M3U files.

Play MP3, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, AAC-LC, ALAC, Ogg Vorbis, Ogg Opus, AC-3 and E-AC-3 files. Audio from MP4, MKV and WebM files works when the audio codec is supported. Files play from their original location. Protected files are not supported.

LIBRARY
Browse the playlist by track or by album with cover art from your folders. Search, sort and reorder tracks, and keep saved playlists. Open a folder from your device or from a WebDAV server on your network.

SOUND CONTROLS
Adjust the ten-band equalizer and preamp. Set volume and balance, and view a spectrum analyzer or oscilloscope.

PIXEL SKINS
Choose an original Catamp skin or import a compatible skin you have permission to use. Cranamp remembers your selected skin and playback settings.

No account, advertising or subscription is required. Bring your own audio files or stream URLs. Cranamp does not provide a commercial music catalogue.

SKIN STUDIO
Draw with pixel tools and paint layers. Edit exact colours, compare button states, and preview the result in the player. Change playlist and visualizer colours, build a bitmap font, edit window cutouts, and draw cursor artwork. Zoom and pan the canvas. The controls adapt to the available window width. Save layered CSTUDIO projects or export WSZ skins.

The tab bar has Player, Library, Skin Studio and Settings. To start drawing, open the Skin Studio tab and choose Open working copy. Settings has day, night, automatic and skin-coloured themes.

On iOS, HLS streams use system playback and do not support the equalizer, balance or visualizer. These controls work with supported local files and direct audio streams.
apple_ios.whats_new: New tabs for Player, Library, Skin Studio and Settings. The Library shows albums with their cover art, searches, sorts and reorders the playlist, and keeps saved playlists. Folders on a WebDAV server play from their original location. Choose a day, night, automatic or skin-coloured theme. Album artwork appears in the system media controls. Settings has an About page with offline open source licenses. Added AC-3 and E-AC-3 playback and the Catamp Aqua Mischief skin.
apple_ios.review_notes:
Cranamp opens on the Player tab with an empty playlist. No account, purchase or
subscription is needed. Cranamp does not supply a music catalogue.

Download the generated sample from https://cranamp.dmitrysamoylenko.in/review/playback-check.wav. To test playback, press the eject button (Open audio files) to the right of the playback buttons in the skinned player, then select the downloaded file in the system file picker. Selecting the file starts playback. Pause, Play and Stop are in the same row. The sample is a generated two-minute tone, with no commercial recording.

The tab bar at the bottom has Player, Library, Skin Studio and Settings. To test a
folder, open Library, tap Add music, then Choose a music folder. The app starts as
tracks are found. It keeps file references and reads selected audio from its
original location. It does not copy the library or convert whole tracks. The
selected storage provider must remain available.

To open Skin Studio, tap the Skin Studio tab, then Open working copy. Canvas has
the drawing tools. Skin has playlist and visualizer colours, bitmap font
generation, window cutouts and cursor artwork. Save and share exports CSTUDIO
projects or WSZ skins. Imported skins and projects contain images and settings;
they do not execute downloaded code.

Settings has the theme, the skin gallery and an About page with the version,
support contact, privacy policy and offline open source licenses.

The first screenshot shows the player. The store edition has no self-update
interface or installer capability. Updates come from the store.

The iOS build has no MCP server. HLS streams use system playback, so HLS does not
support the equalizer, balance or visualizer. Those controls work with supported
local files and direct audio streams.

Browse the playlist by track or by album with cover art from your folders. Search, sort and reorder tracks, and keep saved playlists. Open a folder from your device or from a WebDAV server on your network.

Adjust the ten-band equalizer and preamp. Set volume and balance, and view a spectrum analyzer or oscilloscope.

Choose an original Catamp skin or import a compatible skin you have permission to use. Cranamp remembers your selected skin and playback settings.

No account, advertising or subscription is required. Bring your own audio files or stream URLs. Cranamp does not provide a commercial music catalogue.

SKIN STUDIO
Draw with pixel tools and paint layers. Edit exact colours, compare button states, and preview the result in the player. Change playlist and visualizer colours, build a bitmap font, edit window cutouts, and draw cursor artwork. Zoom and pan the canvas. The controls adapt to the available window width. Save layered CSTUDIO projects or export WSZ skins.

MCP AGENT CONNECTION
Connect a separate MCP agent to the desktop editor. Start the local server, copy its URL and check the connection in Studio. Agent edits appear on your canvas and share your undo history. The server is off by default, accepts connections only from this computer and stops when Studio closes. Agents can use files that Cranamp can access. An agent may require its own account or service.

Arrange the player, equalizer and playlist as movable, dockable desktop windows.

To open Studio, click the lower-right corner of the top player window. In Settings, choose Open Skin Studio, then Open working copy.

Folders on a WebDAV server play from their original location. Choose a day, night, automatic or skin-coloured theme. Album artwork appears in the system media controls. Settings has an About page with offline open source licenses. Added AC-3 and E-AC-3 playback and the Catamp Aqua Mischief skin. Skin pixels align with the screen at every scale.
apple_macos.review_notes:
Cranamp opens in the music player with an empty playlist. No account, purchase or
subscription is needed. Cranamp does not supply a music catalogue.

Download the generated sample from https://cranamp.dmitrysamoylenko.in/review/playback-check.wav. To test playback, press the eject button to the right of the playback buttons in the top window, then select the downloaded file in the system file picker. Selecting the file starts playback. Pause, Play and Stop are in the
same row. The sample is a generated two-minute tone, with no commercial recording.

To test a folder, open the plus button (ADD) at the bottom-left of the playlist
and choose ADD FOLDER. The app starts as tracks are found. It keeps file references
and reads selected audio from its original location. It does not copy the library
or convert whole tracks. The selected storage provider must remain available.

To open Skin Studio, press the lower-right corner of the top player window to
open Settings. Choose Open Skin Studio, then Open working copy. Canvas has the
drawing tools. Skin has playlist and visualizer colours, bitmap font generation,
window cutouts and cursor artwork. Save and share exports CSTUDIO projects or
WSZ skins. Imported skins and projects contain images and settings; they do not
execute downloaded code.

The first screenshot in each gallery shows the player. The other screenshots show
Studio after these steps. The store edition has no self-update interface or
installer capability. Updates come from the store.

MCP is available only in the desktop editor. In Studio, open Agent connection from
the top toolbar, or Project actions in a narrow window. Start server and Test
connection exercise the local service. No separate agent account is needed to
test these controls. The service binds to 127.0.0.1, stays off between sessions
and stops when Studio closes. It can edit the active skin and use files within
the app's permissions. The interface explains that a connected agent may send
the data it reads to its own provider. Cranamp does not call an AI provider itself.

The Mac App Store build uses App Sandbox with access to user-selected files.
Incoming network access supports the user-started local MCP service.
